posts.videoTitle: Take a photo of what's on the counter. Dinner is in there.
posts.text:
Cherry tomatoes, scallions, corn, a head of cauliflower. That's a photo, and the photo is a recipe.

Point the camera at the counter or the fridge, and iEatz lists what it sees, then builds tonight's dinner from exactly those ingredients. No typing, no list.

#whatsfordinner #fridgecooking #weeknightdinner #recipeapp #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: The cauliflower is the one everybody forgets they bought. It roasts in 20 minutes.
posts.alt: Vertical reel: a cook slicing cherry tomatoes on a wooden board with scallions, corn and a cauliflower on the counter. Headline over the photo: Take a photo of what's on the counter. Dinner is in there.

posts.text:
The jars first, then the bowl. Red lentils, bulgur, split peas and rice keep for a year; the bowl takes 20 minutes.

Roasted chickpea and bulgur bowl, serves 2: drain a can of chickpeas, toss with olive oil, cumin and salt, roast at 425°F for 18 minutes. Meanwhile cook 1/2 cup bulgur in a cup of water, 12 minutes. Pile both over a handful of greens with whatever is open (edamame, olives, chopped tomato and cucumber), a spoon of yogurt and a squeeze of lemon. About 18 g of protein per bowl, estimated. Verify for allergens.

#pantrymeals #chickpeas #mealprep #budgetmeals #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: The figs in the bowl were a bonus from the fruit drawer. Not required, strongly encouraged.
posts.alt: Collage on deep cream paper: a photo of glass pantry jars of red lentils, bulgur, split peas and rice, taped at an angle, and a photo of a bowl of roasted chickpeas with greens, edamame, olives, tomato and naan. Handwritten notes: lentils, bulgur, peas; then the bowl. Headline: Shelf-stable, still dinner.

posts.text:
Soup season starts on the pantry shelf. Four soups, one pot each, every one built from a can or a cup of something dry plus broth and one green thing:

1. White bean and kale, 20 minutes, est. 15 g protein
2. Tomato and chickpea, 25 minutes, est. 12 g
3. Red lentil and coconut, 30 minutes, est. 17 g
4. Black bean, 20 minutes, est. 16 g

Steps on the slides. Protein and time are estimates per serving; verify for allergens. Save this for the first cold night.

#soupseason #pantrymeals #highproteinmeals #mealprep #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: Which one first? The red lentil coconut is the one that converts people who say they don't like lentils.
posts.alt: Six-slide carousel on cream paper. Slide one: Four soups that start on the pantry shelf, with a readout of 4 soups, 20 to 30 minutes, 12 to 17 g protein per bowl estimated. Slides two to five: numbered steps for white bean and kale soup, tomato and chickpea soup, red lentil and coconut soup, and black bean soup, each with estimated protein, minutes and servings. Slide six: Four cans, four soups, one pot.

posts.text:
You picked pan-seared chicken with asparagus and spinach. You have the chicken. iEatz checks the recipe against what's in your kitchen, finds the six things missing, and hands them to Instacart as a cart at the store you already use.

No retyping the list. No wandering the aisles for the one thing.

#instacart #grocerylist #mealplanning #weeknightdinner #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: Yes, asparagus in October. It was on sale. The app does not judge.
posts.alt: Mint card with a phone showing the iEatz hand-off to Instacart: the missing items for pan-seared chicken with asparagus and spinach, with a button to add six items to a Ralphs cart. Headline: The missing six go to Instacart.

posts.text:

posts.text:
One dozen eggs, three meals, 22 to 24 g of protein each. The eggs, the avocado and the spinach on this board cover a dinner and two breakfasts:

1. Cheesy egg and black bean quesadillas, 12 minutes (dinner, serves 2)
2. Savory oats with a jammy egg, 10 minutes
3. Black bean and egg skillet, rolled into a wrap, 9 minutes

Steps on the slides, full recipes free on ieatzhealthy.com/recipes. Protein is per serving.

#eggs #highproteinbreakfast #kidsdinner #cheapmeals #ieatzhealthy

posts.videoTitle: Half the week is on this receipt
posts.text:
$25.24 at the register: a dozen eggs, a can of black beans, tortillas, cheddar, a pound of chicken tenders and a tub of Greek yogurt.

iEatz read it as four meals. Monday, cheesy egg and black bean quesadillas (12 minutes). Tuesday, crispy yogurt ranch tenders (25). Wednesday, the leftover tenders rolled into lunchbox wraps. Thursday, black bean and egg breakfast wraps (9). The panko, salt and ranch seasoning were already home.

The quesadillas, the tenders and the breakfast wrap are free on ieatzhealthy.com/recipes.

#groceryhaul #budgetmeals #kidsdinner #mealplanning #ieatzhealthy
posts.firstComment: The yogurt does double duty: it's the tender marinade on Tuesday and the dip on the side.
posts.alt: Vertical reel: a receipt from Corner Market prints line by line on deep green, listing eggs, black beans, tortillas, cheddar, chicken tenders and Greek yogurt for $25.24, then four meals appear below it with a yellow sticker reading 4 meals. Headline: Half the week is on this receipt.

posts.title: Pesto salmon with cauliflower rice: 20 minute high protein dinner (est. 38 g)
posts.text: Seared salmon over cauliflower rice with green beans, cherry tomatoes, pesto and pine nuts, one pan, 20 minutes. Sear the salmon skin side down 4 minutes and flip for 3; steam the beans and the cauliflower rice in the same pan with a splash of water; spoon pesto over, scatter tomatoes and pine nuts. About 38 g of protein per serving, estimated; verify for allergens. iEatz builds dinners like this from what is in your fridge, free on the App Store.
